description: Connect a custom domain to your Fleet project.
variableDescription: %host%: the subdomain the user is pointing at Fleet (e.g. app). %ownershipRecordName%/%ownershipRecordValue%: Cloudflare's ownership verification TXT, returned by Fleet's API when the domain is added. %sslRecordName%/%sslRecordValue%: Cloudflare's certificate validation TXT, returned the same way.
